critique_history.assessment:
- Numerous piping and seam curves float several feet above the bed; remove them or place them directly on the bedding.
- The folded comforter looks like rigid stacked tubes rather than a soft folded quilt; flatten and widen the folds.
- Pillow placement is inconsistent between views and some pillows resemble bars; use fuller, clearly separated pillow forms at the head.
- Preserve the decorative boards while keeping all ornament physically attached.
The complete bed has a well-proportioned wooden frame, decorative boards, tapered legs, green mattress, layered pink bedding, folded comforter, and arranged pillows.
